item.title: Candle Ad Without Photos

turns.text: I don't have a photo. Make a 15-second 9:16 ad for a candle: clear straight-sided glass jar, ivory wax, one wick, no label. Warm evening light, gentle camera moves and soft piano, no voice. Show “A little evening calm”, then finish with “Find your glow”.

item.tests: Tests generating a consistent product from a description alone and delivering a complete 15-second vertical ad.

answer_sheet.Product appearance: Clear straight-sided glass jar with ivory wax, one wick and no label; no photo is available.
answer_sheet.Style and mood: Warm evening light, calm mood and gentle camera movement. Setting and shot choices are your call.
answer_sheet.Text: “A little evening calm”, followed by “Find your glow” at the end.
answer_sheet.Format and duration: One 15-second 9:16 video; free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Audio and language: Soft piano, no voice; English text.

must_haves: One playable vertical 16:9 ad runs for approximately 15 seconds.
The candle has a clear straight-sided glass jar, ivory wax, one wick and no label.
The candle's design stays consistent across shots.
Warm evening lighting and gentle camera movement create a calm product-ad feel.
“A little evening calm” appears before the closing text “Find your glow”, both spelled exactly.
Soft piano is audible with no speech.
After the follow-up, the final result is widescreen 16:9 (the user changed the shape from vertical 9:16); everything else is as before.

changed_by.say: actually, make it widescreen instead of vertical, and keep everything else the same.
